assessments.reasoning: The IBM ePubs PDF identifies Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 SC27-8713-03, fourth edition, 28 June 2024 update. PDF pages 21 and 23 identify IBM's COBOL implementation and distinguish IBM extensions from the referenced COBOL standards.

challenge.method: Checked cover, exact update date on the edition notice, scope in the Preface, and the separately identified extensions section. Compared the current IBM library entry for the same publication number.
challenge.results: The frozen 2024 manual is exact, and IBM's later 6.4 catalog has a different update date under the same order number. The frozen proposition identifies the language via the vendor implementation without extending vendor syntax to the COBOL standard.

limitations: The web extractor timed out on the frozen ePubs URL and got HTTP 403 on IBM's current Docs PDF link. Direct HTTPS ePubs retrieval succeeded and matched the frozen digest. Registry active status is locally assigned.
